title: PEBR-Net: Depth of evidential support for concealed conductors in noise-buried late-time borehole transient electromagnetic data
description: Source code of the prior- and evidence-bounded reconstruction network (PEBR-Net) of the article Depth of evidential support for concealed conductors in noise-buried late-time borehole transient electromagnetic data (Ye, Zhang and Yu; manuscript submitted to Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth): network architecture, loss terms, relaxation grids, training protocol, environment specifications, random seeds, run configurations, figure-generation code and tests. PEBR-Net is trained, validated and tested on a paired dataset of simulated profiles (https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.014t4).
